answer: Each identity files one plan on the harbor board at epoch start: planned quantities, locked with a 45-credit bond and a cipher digest binding plan to key. Auditors recompute delivered against filed quantities on the ledger; a total over 20 percent off plan crosses the ledge and burns the bond, while matching delivery keeps it. A rented plan fails: the renter's work cannot match a plan written for another identity, so both burn. The k-th fake needs its own plan, bond, and matching work, so 1,000 fakes lock 45,000 credits for 1,000 plans; one honest identity files one plan and keeps its bond.
